name: Ubserve
tagline: Paste your URL and find all security issues in 30 seconds
description: Paste your URL and find all security issues in 30 seconds. What it does Ubserve runs attacker-style security scans against live AI-built apps — the ones shipped with Cursor, Lovable, Bolt.new, Windsurf, v0, and Supabase. Unlike a code review, it tests the deployed app, so it catches the runtime access-control flaws static analysis can't see: exposed API keys, missing Supabase RLS, public storage buckets, unauthenticated endpoints, IDOR, leaked env vars, and header/SSL gaps.
